entities.summary: Alexander Beaufort Meek (July 17, 1814 – November 1, 1865 was an American politician, lawyer, judge, and chess player. He also was a writer of historical and literary essays, and poetry. He served as Alabama's Attorney General in 1836. He played several chess games against Paul Morphy.
